notes.title: Minor Patch #1
notes.notes:
Added settings panel with audio sliders.
 Added confirmation panel to "Start New" button. 
 Added button to lockpicking minigame to see tutorial panel again.
 Fixed some typos.
 Road Merchant and Box-boy should now recognize your gender correctly.


If you encounter any dead end or any other bug don't hesitate to report it.
It's extremely hard to test every corner of this game.

notes.title: Road To Wealth – Release Date Revealed!
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to announce that Road To Wealth will be released on June 20th, 2025!

This is not just a story – it’s your story.
Road To Wealth is a text-driven RPG where your decisions shape who you become. Make tough choices, gather your wealth, play through unique minigames, and face the unpredictable twists of life.

🔹 Branching narratives
🔹 Strategic choices with long-term consequences
🔹 Immersive atmosphere and writing
🔹 Fun and varied minigames integrated into the story

Whether you seek power, wealth, or simply want to survive – every playthrough offers a different path.

🗓️ Release Date: June 20th, 2025 💬 Add to your Wishlist and get ready to walk your own Road To Wealth.
